$comment: Edge Guard: one Vercel Firewall template for every project in team Kaminski. Written in LOG mode; apply.sh --mode enforce derives the blocking version. Rules are matched by name, so re-running is idempotent and never touches rules it did not create. Hobby allows 3 custom rules per project, 1 of them rate limiting.

rules.name: edge-guard: rate limit /api
rules.description: More than 60 requests in 60s from one IP on /api/*. Enforce: deny, plus a 15m persistent block on Pro (persistent actions do not exist on Hobby; the deny still applies).

rules.name: edge-guard: deny junk on /api
rules.description: No or blank User-Agent on /api/*. Add abusive ASNs or user agents found in Phase 0 as extra OR groups here; the third slot is taken by the bypass below.

rules.name: edge-guard: exempt /api from Bot Protection
rules.description: Bot Protection challenges anything that is not a browser, which would break webhooks (Stripe, Twilio, Slack), MCP clients and server-to-server calls. Custom rules run before managed rulesets, so /api/* still meets the two rules above first.

projectOverrides.$comment: Per-project exceptions, keyed by project name. Applied after the mode is resolved.

genome-of-games.$comment: This site invites AI crawlers on purpose (robots.txt, llms.txt). Decide at the go/no-go whether AI Bots should deny here.
